description: Only JUnit 5 test code and the production class it tests are pasted: no JaCoCo, no test results, no scope. The production class mixes a static nested class, a nested exception class, an anonymous Comparator inside a lambda, varargs, Map<String, List<Item>> generics, method references and arrays. The test class contains several low-quality tests: a tautological assertEquals(x, x), an empty test body, a commented-out @Test and a private @Test method that JUnit 5 will never run. The tool must report actual coverage as NOT VERIFIED.

quality.note: assertEquals(expected, expected) compares a value with itself; the filter output is never checked.
Whole test including its @Test annotation is commented out with //; it is the only test that would call placeholders().
@Test on a private method: JUnit Jupiter does not execute private test methods.

notes: coverageStatus is an extension key: with no JaCoCo paste the tool must say actual coverage is NOT VERIFIED and must not estimate a percentage from the test code.

testMethods lists the 8 methods carrying @Test, including the empty one and the private one. The commented-out placeholdersAreListedInOrder (test lines 57-60) is NOT a test method; it is only reported as COMMENTED_TEST.
Test class uses the wildcard static import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.* (assertEquals/assertThrows come from it) plus AssertJ assertThat, and @TestInstance(PER_CLASS).
Test string literals contain "{{name}}", "{{ orderId }}" and ";" - braces inside strings must not affect brace depth.

Production: Javadoc lines 15 and 18 contain "{{...}}" and ";"; the regex literal on line 23 contains escaped braces; Javadoc line 50 contains JSON-like braces. byChannel (line 51) contains a lambda whose body is an anonymous Comparator<Item> class with an @Override method (lines 56-61); compare() belongs to the anonymous class, not to TemplateRenderer.

Nested types: TemplateRenderer.Item (static final nested class, line 80, methods name/channel) and TemplateRenderer.MissingPlaceholderException (static nested RuntimeException, line 99). They are reached only indirectly; productionClasses lists only the top-level class.
placeholders() is called only from the commented-out test, so it is in noTestMethods. applyFilter() is called only by the tautological test and the never-run private test.
